plan.purpose: Sample joint interactions instead of optimizing wind or legacy column sinks only at fixed rain settings. Prior best winds lie at the lower sampled boundary; introduce a separately declared 2.5–8.5m/s range while retaining native circulation errors. Sample legacy sink strengths continuously from zero to their retained values, without claiming that removal is a physical correction.
plan.physical_definition: Free only the six declared shared coefficients. Preserve independent water, conservative horizontal/donor vertical transport, corrected rain/recycling, environmental6K/km, all other actual parameters, geometry and Earth properties. Parameter ranges are sensitivity bounds, not physical confidence intervals.
plan.control: Four exact profiles on seven regions precede all 32 Sobol profiles; reproduce all archived main fields and native companions.
plan.screen: Newpolicy: assess hard physical/structural eligibility separately from observational skill. Noindividualregion, nativehumidity orSST prediction-errorveto duringoptimization. Penalize average andregional/native/oceanregret explicitly; report every raw error and original strict-gate violation ascontext in publication. Missing/nonfinite scores, unpairedcases/footprints and changedfixedparameters failclosed. No alteration ofoldcampaignresults.
plan.advance: Same research shortlist; no local refinement, adaptive extension or adoption. Any finalist needs separately declared broader validation.
plan.publication: Every fixed six-dimensional point, failure, source/input identity and prediction tradeoff. New finite coverage is not a global-optimum certificate.

design.local_rule: No local proposals in this joint coverage experiment; best-point bookkeeping only.

plan.publication_title: Joint global wind, rain and drying search
plan.publication_design_text: Thirty-two fixed scrambled Sobol points jointly cover storm exchange, rain timescale, convective RH, background wind amplitude and both legacy drying coefficients. Wind is separately extended to 2.5–8.5 m/s; drying ranges from zero to its retained strength. All remaining actual parameters and planetary properties stay fixed. No local proposals follow.
